promise: Epic announced a $30 million prize pool for the Fortnite World Cup finals on July 26-28, 2019.
description: Epic announced a US$30 million prize pool for the July 26-28, 2019 World Cup solo and duo finals. Its July 31 recap confirms the finals took place with that pool. The separate US$100 million season commitment was not the finals prize pool.
evidence: Epic's February 22 announcement distinguishes the finals pool from the broader competitive season.
Epic's July 31 post-event recap records the completed finals and US$30 million solo/duo prize pool. This assesses the announced event pool, not the settlement date of every winner's payment.
